Exact approved individual from reference1: The round mud-covered bathhouse stink spirit from Spirited Away, gentle muddy brown lumpy body with a small kind right-facing face, small reeds and harmless twigs caught in moss, holding a large green lotus leaf umbrella. Reference2 STYLE ONLY. Animate lotus leaf rim and dangling reeds ripple; solid seated body stays stable; a few attached clean light beads glimmer. Keep face/rigid torso/chest and main props at SAME cell-relative coordinates and SAME scale, screen-RIGHT profile all4. FRAMING IS CRITICAL: each COMPLETE subject is SMALL within its OWN cell, maximum68 percent of cell long axis; at least16 percent EMPTY ALPHA on EACH of four sides within EACH cell. Centers at image quarter positions. Especially keep entire lotus leaf, umbrella stem and all dangling reeds safely inside its cell. No frame labels, no grid, no motion dashes, no detached particles or glows, no scenery, no floor strip. Preserve body proportions and right-facing orientation; never crop. No pulse/zoom/camera movement. Only flexible appendages change, create a smooth loop, not identical copies or only eye changes. Genuine transparent background.
